decision_reason: Hold: Plasmopy is an Agroscope-sponsored, runnable Python rewrite of the older VitiMeteo-Plasmopara model, but the evidence currently does not verify a versioned release artifact or product-specific operational deployment/reuse for this Python product. The older VitiMeteo service deployment cannot establish notability for Plasmopy itself.

government_provenance.note: The first-party publiccode manifest names Agroscope as developer/funder and used-by; the repository README identifies the Agroscope forecasting model lineage.

public_source.note: The public repository contains the Python model, input/output examples, configuration, tests and a Streamlit application.

eligible_license.note: The LICENSE grants AGPL-3.0-only; it is present from the repository's first commit on 2025-07-09 (https://github.com/agroscope-ch/plasmopy/commit/28ac48447c849e09e28c725fa31c0044b8fbfd28).

primary_evidence.note: The README is headed Plasmopy v1.0 and provides Poetry setup, make setup/run/app instructions, and optional cron/FTP deployment guidance. publiccode.yml and the official Swiss catalog declare softwareVersion 1.0 and release date 2025-07-09, but GitHub shows no Release/tag or package artifact, and the deployment instructions are generic rather than evidence that Agroscope or another user operates this Python rewrite. Agroscope confirms broad operational adoption only for the older VitiMeteo/Agrometeo system: https://www.agroscope.admin.ch/fr/aides-a-la-decision.

agency: Agroscope, Swiss federal agricultural research institute
family_note: Keep this Python rewrite separate from the older VitiMeteo-Plasmopara model and Agrometeo service. The catalog and README name Plasmopy v1.0, but no verifiable versioned release artifact or product-specific deployment/reuse was found.
status_note: To clear hold, provide either a verifiable Plasmopy v1.0 artifact (tagged source release, package, or downloadable release) together with install/user guidance, or direct primary documentation showing deployment/reuse of the Plasmopy Python code itself. The official Agroscope description of the widely used Agrometeo/VitiMeteo system is not evidence that this rewrite is deployed.
